title: "User Guide"
guide-section: "Start here"
---

This is the narrative layer of the documentation — the *why* behind the code.
It sits next to two other layers:

| Layer | What it answers | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| README / home | What is this and how do I run it? | Landing page |
| **User Guide** | How does it fit together, what do the words mean? | You are here |
| API Reference | Exact signatures and behaviour, per symbol | Reference (navbar) |

**Reading paths:**

* *New to the codebase* → [Architecture](00-architecture.qmd) for the map,
  then [Core concepts](01-concepts.qmd) for the vocabulary (pools, aliases,
  rounds, purchases), then wander into the Reference from there.
* *Evaluating strategies* → the architecture page's "leak rules" section
  first, because everything else is designed around them.

::: {.callout-tip}
Every API page links back to its source file, so the docstring you read here
is the one in the code — they cannot drift apart.
:::
